A sun storm scientist, irrationality analyst and moonshot expert anyone? Another year, another phenomenal WIRED summit. 

Backed by Telefonica since its inception, the iconic annual event took place earlier in November this year. It featured some of world’s most pioneering minds each exploring tomorrow's trends.
